meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 它会通过 signal-cli 把助手作为副设备链接到你现有的 Signal 手机号,之后助手用该号码收发 Signal 私聊与群聊,并可把某个聊天接到指定的助手分组。
howto.when: 当你要给助手加上 Signal 渠道时触发;通常在 /setup 流程里,或要把 Signal 私聊、群聊接进去时。

say.text: 帮我加上 Signal 渠道
say.note: 会安装 signal-cli 并引导你扫码链接设备

say.text: 把这个 Signal 群接到我的助手
say.note: 先在该群发一条消息生成记录,再完成接线

say.text: 给这个 Signal 用户开访问权限

howto.what_en: It links your assistant to your existing Signal number as a secondary device via signal-cli. The assistant then sends and receives Signal DMs and groups as that number, and chats can be wired to an agent group.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Signal channel to your assistant, typically during /setup or when hooking up Signal DMs and groups.

say_en.text: Add the Signal channel for me
say_en.note: Installs signal-cli and walks you through scanning the link QR

say_en.text: Connect this Signal group to my assistant
say_en.note: Send a message in the group first to create the row, then wire it
New Signal users are dropped as not_member until granted
